title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: StrongDM
providers.scope_notes: SaaS control plane (US/UK/EU); Log Stream and 13-month log viewing require the Enterprise plan, other plans see 30 days in the Admin UI.

controls.name: Delete token
controls.what: Deleting an admin token stops it authenticating immediately.
controls.setting: Principals > Tokens; sdm admin tokens delete

controls.name: Rotate
controls.what: Generates a new secret with the same permissions; existing authentications expire after 24 hours.

controls.name: Token permissions
controls.what: Each admin token or API key gets only the admin permissions chosen at creation.
controls.setting: Create Admin Token / Create API Key page; --permissions

controls.name: Token expiry
controls.what: Set an expiry at creation; 'never' is an allowed choice.

controls.name: Delete tokens on user suspension
controls.what: When suspending a user, the Admin UI lists their tokens and keys and asks whether to delete them.

controls.name: Permission level: Manage service accounts, admin tokens, and API keys
controls.what: Only the Administrator permission level can create or manage admin tokens, API keys, and service accounts; other levels cannot.

no_control.what: Suspending the creating user does not disable admin tokens.

controls_unknown: Any IP allowlist for admin tokens, API keys, service accounts, or SCIM tokens (docs silent).
Any org-wide switch to block creation of admin tokens or API keys, or a maximum expiry policy.
Whether SSO-required or MFA settings apply to service account token logins.
SCIM token rotation, revocation, and lifetime.
Service account token lifetime and rekey procedure.
Whether read-only SDK/API calls (e.g. listing accounts or resources) are recorded as Activities.
Whether API key creation logs as 'Admin token created' or a separate event.

authentication.summary: Single secret string used with the sdm CLI via SDM_ADMIN_TOKEN or sdm login --admin-token. It can only run the sdm admin commands granted to it, and use skips the interactive login.

federation.details: Static secret; no documented workload identity federation.

ip_restriction.boundary: Docs do not describe any IP allowlist for admin tokens.

lifetime.summary: 1 week, 1 month, 1 year, or never (CLI duration default 0)

renewal.summary: Rotate regenerates the secret with same name and permissions; old authentications expire after 24 hours.

administration.summary: Admins create, list, rotate and delete in Principals > Tokens or sdm admin tokens. Tokens survive suspension of the creating user unless deleted.
administration.conditions: Administrator permission level needed to create via CLI.

sso.details: Docs say a CLI session using an admin token does not need a CLI or GUI login, so the SSO login flow is not involved.

offboard.details: Admin tokens keep working after the creating user is suspended unless the admin chooses to delete them in the suspension prompt.

inventory.details: Admin UI Principals > Tokens and `sdm admin tokens list` list all tokens in the org; `sdm audit tokens` gives a point-in-time listing.

token_format.notes: Opaque string shown once; prefix not documented.

log_sources.name: Activities (Admin UI Logs > Activities, sdm audit activities, API Activities)
log_sources.notes: 30 days in Admin UI without Enterprise, 13 months with Enterprise.

log_sources.name: Log Stream - Activities
log_sources.notes: Enterprise; streams to customer object storage.

credential_id_fields.notes: Account that performed the activity; whether token ID is separately recorded is not documented.

anomaly_cues: Admin activity from unfamiliar ipAddress or userAgent

containment.steps: Delete the token in Principals > Tokens or with sdm admin tokens delete. Prefer delete over rotate: rotation lets existing authentications live up to 24 hours.
containment.notes: Docs say delete is immediate, but the rotate tooltip says existing authentications expire after 24 hours.

unknown: Whether each admin command run with the token is an Activity

calls.log_notes: Activities cover administrative changes; reads not stated.

calls.call: sdm admin datasources list / sdm admin servers list

unknown: No documented whoami for admin tokens

evidence.title: View Logs from the Admin UI
